visual.description: A man looking frustrated and tired while working at a messy desk.

vo.en: Most people think doing favors is the only way to build a friendship. But it's actually the opposite.
vo.fr: On pense souvent que rendre service crée des liens. Mais c'est l'inverse qui fonctionne le mieux.

visual.description: Two men in business casual attire performing a firm handshake in a sunny park.

vo.en: It’s called the Ben Franklin effect. He famously turned an enemy into a friend just by asking to borrow a rare book.
vo.fr: C'est l'effet Ben Franklin. Il a transformé ses ennemis en alliés en leur demandant simplement d'emprunter un livre.

visual.description: A close-up of old, leather-bound books on a dark wooden library shelf.

vo.en: Your brain hates logical inconsistency. When you do a favor for someone, your mind convinces itself you must like them.
vo.fr: Ton cerveau déteste l'incohérence. Si tu aides quelqu'un, ton esprit conclut forcément que tu apprécies cette personne.

visual.description: An extreme close-up of a human eye blinking with abstract light reflections.

vo.en: Next time you meet someone, ask for a small favor—like a pen or a quick recommendation. It builds instant rapport.
vo.fr: Demande un petit service, comme un stylo ou un conseil. Cela crée un lien immédiat sans effort.

visual.description: Close up of a hand handing a silver pen to another person's hand.

vo.en: They will subconsciously start trusting you. Master the next social hack here. That is why you should...
vo.fr: Ils te feront plus confiance. Maîtrise d'autres astuces sociales ici. Voilà pourquoi tu dois...

visual.description: A confident man walking through a modern city towards the camera.
